8. Educate healthcare and aging services professionals on the best ways to support families and caregivers of older adults with dementia.
Healthcare and aging services professionals can be instrumental in supporting AI/AN caregivers with information and guidance. They can also facilitate access to affordable, evidence-informed services, programs, interventions, and supports for caregivers to reduce their stress and improve coping, self-efficacy, and overall health.
